title: Nature's dance-off: display vs directions

scenes.headline: Dance-off, round 1: the show-offs
scenes.body: Peacock: train up and rattling. Hummingbird: wings out, tail fanned.

scenes.headline: This dancer performs in the dark, inside the hive.
Angle = direction to food. Waggle time = distance.
The bee. Its dance gives directions.
scenes.body: Karl von Frisch shared the 1973 Nobel Prize partly for decoding it.

caption:
Two dances to impress, one dance with a message.

A forager bee's waggle run is angled relative to the sun's direction, and the longer it waggles, the farther away the flowers are.

Source: Britannica, NobelPrize.org.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Bracket-style dance-off across three species; bee shots are portraits of the dancer (labelled as dancing inside the hive), not footage of the dance itself.
